scope: Single-example training memorization diagnostic; not held-out accuracy, deforestation deployment readiness or onset-date inference.

selection.rule: First accepted manifest record, fixed before observing diagnostic results; no candidate search or best-case reselection.
selection.input_handling: Unchanged exported finite features, signed indices/differences, labels 0/1/255; no augmentation, rescaling, clipping, offset crops or additional labels.

fixed_protocol.initialization: Exact identical initial state SHA256 across all three arms, from seed42; reset seed before make_model.
fixed_protocol.loss: masked BCE mean over exactly P+N reviewed pixels; 255 selected out before computation
fixed_protocol.prediction_rule: Logit >=0 is positive (probability >=0.5); threshold is frozen, not tuned.

arms.comparison_role: Reference with previous global pilot class weight; checkpoints show fixed-case exposure over time.
Only class weight differs from global_weight_sgd; isolates weight choice within this one case.
Predeclared optimization sanity variant; optimizer AND learning rate differ from local_weight_sgd, so differences cannot be attributed solely to optimizer.

analytic_constant_prediction_baselines.interpretation: The existing equal-image training objective has an above-half constant optimum under a global pixel-derived class weight. This is an analytic prior-bias explanation, not an empirical attribution of all-positive collapse. The diagnostic comparisons are required.

validity_gates: All three arms use the exact same selected tensors, reviewed mask, initialization and fixed checkpoint schedule.
Finite reviewed loss, finite gradients and finite model state; an actual parameter change must occur overall. Record zero deltas/stalling rather than inventing updates.
Source dataset and selected artifact hashes and class counts remain unchanged.
Ignored-logit gradients remain zero; all-ignored safety skips model forward and optimizer step.
All resource guards pass; any resource or numerical abort is distinct from a valid completed arm whose fit gate fails.

fit_gate.case_integer_implication: With P=25,N=256, this requires at least24 true positives and no more than1 false positive.
fit_gate.raw_BCE_cutoff_reason: Raw weighted-BCE scale changes with class weight; a shared absolute cutoff would unfairly compare arms. Report raw and mean-weight-normalized losses and their curves as diagnostics.
fit_gate.secondary_reporting: Record first passing PREDECLARED checkpoint if any, but do not stop early or replace the primary final512 outcome with a best checkpoint.
fit_gate.failure_semantics: A finite completed arm can fail the memorization gate; retain its results as evidence, not a processing error.

resource_limits.frozen_guard: validate_sample.run_guarded; do not modify existing frozen QA-policy files.

interpretation_limits: A passing fit demonstrates capacity to memorize only the reviewed pixels of one training crop, not generalization or full-image label correctness.
Longer-run checkpoint differences diagnose fixed-case exposure, not a direct reproduction of the original 13-case two-pass smoke.
SGD global versus local isolates only weight choice on this case; both may fit eventually despite different priors and transient curves.
Adam comparison changes optimizer and learning rate together; it is a sanity variant, not a causal optimizer experiment.
No held-out images, threshold tuning, timing inference, new annotations or source pixel rereads belong to this task.

diagnostic_reporting.ranking: Exact positive-versus-negative pairwise AUC on reviewed pixels only; descriptive training diagnostic, no threshold selection.
